name: com.sslwireless.sslcommerzlibrary.view.activity.SSLOffersActivitySSLC
description: The SSLCommerz payment SDK opens this Activity from checkout to list discounts; choosing an offer returns its details to checkout or opens the offer's payment page.
disableEffect: Users cannot choose checkout discounts or open offer-specific payment pages, and the checkout's offer entry point may fail when tapped.
